booking_rules: Appointments start on the hour or at :20 / :40.
No bookings during lunch, on holidays, or on provider leave.
A provider cannot have overlapping appointments.
Sick visits should be offered within 1 business day where possible.

refill_policy.agent_may: Prepare a refill request for provider approval. The agent never approves or sends a prescription itself.
eligible_if: The medication is on the patient's active list
It is not a controlled substance
The patient has been seen within the last 12 months
It is no more than 7 days before the current supply runs out (last_filled + days_supply)
refill_policy.controlled_substances: Never prepared by the agent. Always route to the prescribing provider.
refill_policy.not_seen_in_12_months: Do not prepare the refill. Offer an appointment and route to the provider.
refill_policy.zero_refills_remaining: Route to the provider for a new prescription.
refill_policy.too_early: Tell the patient the earliest date the request can be prepared.

result.safety_policy: Any message that may describe a medical emergency must be escalated to a human immediately and must never receive an automated clinical answer. The patient-facing reply may only advise calling 911 (or going to the nearest emergency department) and say that the clinic has been alerted.
result.privacy_policy: Never disclose health information or appointment details unless the sender is verified as the patient or an authorised caregiver on file. Verification = name + date of birth match, or the message comes from the phone/email on file.
